legal.privacyIntro: Modern Gold Jewelry Manufacturing (MG Jewelry) respects your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal data when you use our website, book appointments, or place orders.
legal.privacyCollectBody: We may collect your name, email, phone, delivery address, order details, appointment requests, and support messages that you provide.
legal.privacyUseBody: We use your data to fulfil orders, confirm appointments, answer support requests, improve the site, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.privacyContactBody: Questions about privacy: hello@mgjewelry.uz — Modern Gold Jewelry Manufacturing, 242 Girvonbulok Street, Davlatabad District, Namangan City, Republic of Uzbekistan.
legal.offerIntro: This public offer sets out the terms of sale between Modern Gold Jewelry Manufacturing (Seller) and the Customer for jewelry and related services ordered via the website.
legal.offerGoodsBody: Product descriptions, metals, weights, and prices are shown on the product page. Prices may be displayed in USD and UZS. Final payable amount is confirmed at checkout, including any coupon discount.
legal.offerOrdersBody: An order is accepted when payment is confirmed or when showroom pickup is arranged. Fulfillment may be Namangan showroom pickup, local delivery in Uzbekistan, or an international shipping quote.
legal.offerReturnsBody: Return or support requests can be submitted from your account. Custom or altered pieces may be excluded. Namangan showroom staff will confirm eligibility.
legal.offerSellerBody: Modern Gold Jewelry Manufacturing — 242, Girvonbulok Street, Davlatabad District, Namangan City, Namangan Region, Republic of Uzbekistan. Contact: hello@mgjewelry.uz · Telegram @mgjewelry.
